source_quote: What you find is they lose a lot of fat very, very quickly.
claim_selection: Assistant-selected paraphrase for a retrieval diagnostic; interpret the source quote using the complete transcript. Not an automatic claim-extraction evaluation.

claim.claim_text: People previously eating a lot of processed foods and excess carbohydrates and fats together lose a lot of fat very quickly when they switch to eating only meat, fish, eggs, vegetables and fruit, with water, coffee or tea and without alcohol or milk.
claim.exposure: Switching to the described restricted food list
claim.outcome: Losing a lot of fat very quickly
claim.context: People previously eating a lot of processed foods and excess carbohydrates and fats together; amount and time frame unspecified

(paleolithic[tiab] OR palaeolithic[tiab] OR paleo[tiab]) AND ("body fat"[tiab] OR "fat mass"[tiab] OR adiposity[tiab] OR "weight loss"[tiab])
("ultra-processed"[tiab] OR ultraprocessed[tiab] OR "processed foods"[tiab]) AND ("body fat"[tiab] OR "fat mass"[tiab] OR "weight loss"[tiab])
query_notes: Low-carbohydrate and paleolithic diets are discovery proxies, not assumed equivalents of the exact claimed diet. Queries do not require positive results.
review_questions: Does the tested diet match the actual listed foods and exclusions, or is it only an indirect proxy?
Was body fat measured, or only body weight? Do not equate the two.
What population, comparator, duration, fat-change estimate and uncertainty are reported?
Retain supportive, null and adverse findings. The claim specifies no numerical amount or time frame.
